<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.RescheduleUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><name>RescheduleUtils</name><script><![CDATA[var RescheduleUtils = Class.create();
RescheduleUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    rescheduleAppointment: function() {
        var appointmentId = this.getParameter('sysparm_appointment_id');
        var newDate = this.getParameter('sysparm_new_date');

        if (!appointmentId || !newDate) {
            return JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: "Missing appointment ID or new date." });
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord('u_appointment');
        if (gr.get(appointmentId)) {
            gr.setValue('appointment_date', newDate);
            gr.update();

            // Fire custom event to notify patient
            gs.eventQueue('appointment.rescheduled', gr, gs.getUserID(), gr.u_patient_id);
            return JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: "Appointment rescheduled successfully." });
        }

        return JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: "Appointment not found." });
    }

});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-17 11:29:23</sys_created_on><sys_id>2c41d5ed83be621040a9c8efeeaad313</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>RescheduleUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Healthcare Management Application" source="ff960d23c32e2210dabb554d0501312e">ff960d23c32e2210dabb554d0501312e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Healthcare Management Application">ff960d23c32e2210dabb554d0501312e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_2c41d5ed83be621040a9c8efeeaad313</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-21 09:27:20</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
